transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I suppose I’m here because my family and a few others keep saying I’ve been… taking on too much. I don’t really see it that way, honestly. I feel like somebody has to keep things moving.

We’ve got the move to handle, and I want the new garage built right, not halfway. Then there’s things at church that need organizing, and at work I’m still trying to show the younger fellows how the job ought to be done. I know that might sound like a lot, doctor, but to me it feels more like I’ve just got the drive to get it done.
Have you been needing less sleep than usual lately?

I’m not really sure I’d call it needing less sleep. I mean, I’ve always been someone who can get by if there’s work to be done. Lately I may be up later thinking through plans and such, but… I don’t know if that counts. I still rest some. Is that what you mean?
Have you had any experiences lately where you were hearing or seeing things that other people did not?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t been seeing things or hearing voices or anything like that, if that’s what you mean. Maybe I get focused and notice things other people miss, but nothing… strange like that. Does that answer it?
Have you been feeling unusually upbeat or high lately?

I wouldn’t say “high” exactly… maybe just in good spirits, more sure of myself than usual. I’ve had moments where I’m joking around and feel, well, pretty darn capable—like I’m ten feet tall.

But then if people start questioning the plan, I can get short. I’ve told folks they need to get on board or get out of the way, and I know that probably sounds harsh. I’ve snapped at my wife or my boy over some little question, which… I’m not proud of. Does that make sense?
Have you been talking more than usual lately?

Maybe a little, yes. I mean, I’m not trying to run people over or anything. But once I start explaining what needs to be done, I can… keep going. My family says I talk over them, and that I’m going so fast they can’t even get a word in to tell me to stop.

I guess that’s more than usual, isn’t it?
Have you been more active than usual lately—taking on more projects or staying busier than is typical for you?

Well… yes, I suppose I have been busier than usual. I don’t mean it in a bad way, Doctor. It just feels like there’s a lot that needs doing, and I’m the one with the energy to get it done.

Everyone says I’m doing too much, and that’s part of why I’m here, but to me it seems reasonable. We’ve got the move to handle, the new garage needs to be rebuilt the right way, there are things at church that need organizing, and even at work I’ve been trying to show the younger fellows how the job ought to be done.

Maybe I’ve taken on more than most folks would, but… I’m trying to be useful. That makes sense, doesn’t it?
Have these changes been causing serious problems in your life lately?

I suppose… yes, it has caused some real problems. I don’t like putting it that way, but I should be honest.

At work, they pulled me off after there was a safety incident. I still feel like it got made into a bigger thing than it needed to be, but… I understand why folks were concerned.

And at home, my wife and family have sort of stopped trusting me with certain decisions—money, driving, the move. They say things got out of hand. That’s been hard to hear, Doctor, because I’ve been trying to help, not make trouble. But yes… I guess it’s been serious.
Have you believed lately that you have special powers, a special mission, or abilities far beyond what other people would think is realistic?

Special powers? No, Doctor, I don’t think I’d say that.

I mean… I’ve felt like I know what needs to be done, maybe more clearly than other people seem to, but that’s not the same as having powers or some grand mission. I’m not saying God chose me or anything like that.

I just… sometimes I feel responsible, I suppose. Like if I don’t step in, things won’t get handled right. But “special powers” sounds a bit much to me. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed or lost interest in things most of the day, nearly every day?

I’m not sure I’d say that, Doctor. I mean, everyone has low spells now and then, especially at my age, but two weeks of being depressed most of the day, nearly every day… I don’t really think so.

I haven’t noticed anything like that clearly. I’ve had worries and frustrations, sure, but I wouldn’t want to make it sound worse than it is. Does that answer it the right way?
Have you believed lately that you were receiving special messages meant just for you?

Special messages meant just for me… no, I don’t think so, Doctor.

I mean, I might notice things and think they’re important, but I haven’t felt like the TV or radio or signs or anything were sending me personal messages. At least, not that I’d call it that.

Is that what you mean?
